hint.text:
A metaphor is a figure of speech in which two things that are otherwise unrelated are compared with one another.

A simile is an expression that compares one thing to another by using like or as.

instruction.text: Listen to the sentences and decide if they are metaphors or similes.

atoms.sound: Dana’s room looked like a pigsty.
The pillow was an absolute dream.
The pillow was as soft as a bunny rabbit.
It’s like time is flying by.

instruction.text: Does the following statement include a metaphor or a simile?

atoms.a: She is just as wild as a lion.
Jenny is the definition of relaxed.
He hides his things like a squirrel.
When she’s on her racing bike, it’s like she’s competing in a triathlon.
